variants.prompt: REFORMED LIGHTING/TIME: In the warm glow of candlelight, the alluring woman sits in a plush armchair, her gown a shimmering whisper of silk and beading. The flickering flames cast dancing shadows on her porcelain skin as she leans forward, her emerald eyes gleaming in the soft light. A crystal goblet and a silver snuffer rest on a nearby side table, hinting at a cozy evening of fine wine and seduction.
